description: d-SEAMS reads molecular-dynamics trajectories and names the ice in them: CHILL+, topological cages, primitive rings, and Steinhardt parameters, on one shared neighbour list. This repository is the C++ engine, the C API libseams, the C ABI libseams_lang, and the seams command.
rules: Install the engine with conda install -c conda-forge libseams, or meson setup build && meson compile -C build.
seams reads a trajectory. TIP4P oxygen is --type 2. Monoatomic water such as mW is --type 1. The default cutoff is 3.5 angstrom.
include/seams.h is ABI 1. Handles are opaque. Destroy each handle once. A NULL buffer with a length pointer queries the count.
Python is pydseamslib (import dseams). Lua, R, Julia, Rust, and Fortran bindings are separate repositories at the same version.
Cite Goswami, Goswami, and Singh, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2020, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.0c00031.
Read AGENTS.md before editing seams-core. Do not weaken or delete a test to make the suite pass.
